questions.answer: I got the classes I wanted, but you have to be quick on the website.

questions.answer: Language school was hard but my other class was fine, exam was not oral but written.

questions.answer: Compared to my classes here, my one class was much more passive as a student. I just attended classes and listened while the teacher talked.
